source_differences_for_writers: Endpoints per VPC: PrivateLink FAQ says up to 100 (vpc-endpoints-faq-100-endpoints-per-vpc); the quotas page says 50 interface plus Gateway Load Balancer endpoints per VPC by default, adjustable, and 20 gateway endpoints per Region, up to 255 per VPC. Teach the quotas page.
Peering connections: PrivateLink FAQ says peering is limited to 125; the quotas page says 50 by default, adjustable up to 125.
Public service DNS name: the PrivateLink FAQ says only private endpoint names work; the guide says that with private DNS the public service name resolves to the interface endpoint. Teach the guide.
Endpoint types: the PrivateLink FAQ lists five; tunnel endpoints (2026-09-18) are a sixth type, not examinable yet.
Security group referencing across a transit gateway: the multi-VPC whitepaper table says not supported; the guide (since 2024-09-25) says supported in inbound rules only. Teach the guide.
Gateway endpoints and IPv6: the DynamoDB gateway endpoint page says IPv4 only; S3 gateway and interface endpoints support IPv6 since November 2025.
